description: Interface operator quadratic structure: (sigma-h/2)^2 = 1+h^2/4 = [2]_q^2/4 (SCALAR). Even powers are identity; odd powers are linear in sigma. 5 averaged interface crossings = (1+h^2/4)^2 x single crossing (scalar 1.022). Eigenvalue splitting n_+ - n_- from SYT counting predicts R_lambda SIGN correctly for 9/11 partitions. Extremal (1-dim) blocks match to 2.2%. Middle blocks need full Hoefsmit matrix (Rust hecke-engine).
